children.name: Automated contrast check — WCAG 2.x relative luminance (sRGB), against the page surface (surface/bg/default), for every theme combination. Minimums: 3:1 for the circle, dot and focus ring (non-text UI), 4.5:1 for text. Values are before the Disabled opacity is applied. Note: project-a / light is measured against the current surface/bg/default, which resolves to blue because of the gray/50 token.
